text:
sam.devex: noticed multiple reports of \"fetch is not defined\" in sample-apps on older node. we should standardize guidance for v1.4.
lee.sdk: agree. keep SDK default to using globalThis.fetch when available. provide an explicit injection API: `setFetchImplementation(fn)` + `hasGlobalFetch()` so apps don't have to monkeypatch globals.
priya.infra: 👍 and document recommended runtimes: Edge (Cloudflare/Vercel): no-op; Node >=18: no-op; Node <18: install undici@^5 or use our setFetchImplementation. include Bun caveat (headers behavior).
nana.prod: onboarding asks for one-liners. can we add copy-paste snippets for ESM and CJS and a tiny troubleshooting table?
lee.sdk: yes. planned snippets: ```js
// ESM (Node <18)
import { fetch as undiciFetch } from 'undici'
import { setFetchImplementation } from '@redwood/inference'
setFetchImplementation(undiciFetch)
```
```js
// CJS (Node <18)
const { fetch: undiciFetch } = require('undici')
const { setFetchImplementation } = require('@redwood/inference')
setFetchImplementation(undiciFetch)
```
sam.devex: also include a one-line global shim for quick fixes: `if (!globalThis.fetch) globalThis.fetch = (await import('undici')).fetch` with a note about bundlers.
priya.infra: call out semantic differences: undici stream/abort behavior can differ slightly by version; retries + streaming bodies may need normalization. recommend undici@5 and CI matrix covering node 16/18/20.
lee.sdk: we'll export a FetchLike typedef (`type FetchLike = (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>`) and accept custom fetch typed to that. also add a small internal retry wrapper: retries only idempotent methods by default, uses AbortController, and exposes opt-out hooks.
nana.prod: add a troubleshooting table to quickstart: 
- \"ReferenceError: fetch is not defined\" -> run the ESM/CJS snippet or use global shim
- \"stream aborted mid-response\" -> try undici@latest or switch to native edge runtime
- \"401 then retry causes broken stream\" -> enable SDK refresh-token hook and avoid retrying streaming POSTs
ci-bot: ci:tests triggered by @lee.sdk  2 failing (http-client-compat).
lee.sdk: i'll pick up the failures. likely need a small normalization layer for older undici Response streams. will open PR with tests and docs updates.
sam.devex: thanks — i'll add the quickstart copy and sample-app edits once PR lands.
priya.infra: I'll expand CI matrix to node 16/18/20 and run streaming suites to catch regressions.
